questions.answer: Wicked legal ethics, policy of european law and wicked legal ethics, arbitration and Dutch law.

questions.answer: Policy of european law and wicked legal ethics. These sparked my personal interest and are a bit different than the courses we have in ucph.

Always be openminded
Budget wisely
Try to have the best time
